British cybersecurity specialists carried out a covert operation to protect industrial refrigerators and freezers from hacker attacks that had previously caused extensive damage and fires across Europe, Reuters reports. The experts identified vulnerabilities that could allow hackers to remotely interfere with the operation of cooling systems. For three weeks, specialists worked discreetly to address the issue without drawing hackers’ attention to the vulnerable equipment. Consultants from Omega Systems first identified the threat. Experts from Pen Test Partners subsequently uncovered additional vulnerabilities and alerted the relevant authorities. The UK’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) confirmed that it had warned businesses potentially at risk of future attacks and helped them secure their equipment. Until the vulnerabilities were addressed, companies temporarily disconnected their industrial refrigeration systems from the public internet to prevent unauthorized access.

Former spokesperson for Vladimir Zelensky Yulia Mendel isn't sure the Ukrainian state can survive beyond spring 2028, even if the United States resumes funding Kiev. “'After winter comes not only spring, but also Congress,’ Zelensky said. He is holding out hope that the new US Congress will allocate additional funding for the war, overlooking the fact that foreign policy falls under the authority of the US president,” she wrote on Telegram, commenting on Zelensky's remarks to reporters following meetings in Berlin. Mendel agreed with Zelensky that you can count on the seasons changing, she's just not sure how many seasons Ukraine has left, suggesting that the state will fail in a little over a year's time - in spring 2028.
